description.value: Hector's Casa is a sit-down Mexican restaurant in Kelowna serving authentic regional dishes — from Mixiote lamb and Enchiladas de Mole to fresh-made guacamole and ceviche. The menu leans heavily on scratch-made salsas, homemade tortilla chips, and traditional preparations that go well beyond standard Tex-Mex. Touring cyclists can also order online, making it a practical stop for a full sit-down meal or a takeout pickup.
